item.title: How a $1,600 RTX 4090 Beat an H100 at 100 T/s – The LLM Revolution You're Missing
item.description:
发表方：DEV Community（作者 amrit）　发布：2026-10-05　分类：技术博客

社区项目 Strata 用 int4 量化 + 投机解码 + CUDA graph 融合在单张 RTX 4090 上跑 125B 模型，宣称聚合吞吐约 100 tok/s 量级；数据为自测合成负载，未经第三方核验，谨慎参考。

Qwen 3.8 Flash Next on a Single RTX 4090 Cracks the 100 T/s Barrier

“A $1,600 graphics card now pushes a 125‑billion‑parameter LLM at 100 trillion tokens per second.” – community lead on the Strata repo

The headline sounds like a stunt, but the numbers survive a hard audit. A volunteer team folded the 125 B‑parameter Qwen 3.8 Flash Next model into an RTX 4090 and recorded an aggregate throughput of roughly 100 T tokens / s. This dramatically lowers the cost of large‑scale inference and forces Nvidia to rethink how it markets “data‑center‑only” performance.

Below, I break down the engineering tricks, the benchmark outcomes, the cost calculus, and the competitive picture against Nvidia’s newest GPUs. I also flag the risks that keep this achievement from becoming a universal prescription.

item.title: What Google's TurboQuant Does and Why It Actually Matters
item.description:
发表方：DEV Community（作者 Dishant Sharma）　发布：2026-10-04　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题 KV cache 随上下文长度线性膨胀——单个 Llama-3.1-8B 在 128K 上下文下 KV cache 就占 16GB 显存，24GB 卡几乎放不下权重，长上下文任务首当其冲。

要点 解读 Google Research 的 TurboQuant：随机旋转让向量角度分布高度可预测（PolarQuant），无需为每块存储昂贵的归一化常数；第二级用 1bit QJL 处理残差。文章还汇总了社区在 llama.cpp、MLX、vLLM 上的独立复现验证。

关键数字 KV cache 压到每值 3bit 且零精度损失，16GB 降到约 2.6GB；H100 上注意力计算最高 8x 加速；常规量化常需额外 1–2bit 存储量化常数。

为什么值得看 把论文原理讲得通俗，又收集了多框架复现结果，是快速了解这一 KV 压缩热点的入口。

item.title: Strata Runs 125B Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on a 12GB Gaming GPU
item.description:
发表方：AI Weekly（聚合资讯）　发布：2026-10-04　分类：技术博客

与上一条同一事件（Strata 在 12GB 消费级 GPU 上运行 125B 模型）的聚合报道，无增量技术细节。

Strata Runs 125B Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on a 12GB Gaming GPU

TL;DR

- Open-source Strata runs Qwen3.8-Flash-Next's 125 billion parameters on a single consumer GPU with 12 GB of VRAM and 32 GB of system RAM.

- The model activates only 10 of 24,576 experts per token, and a built-in speculative drafter is claimed to add a 1.6-1.8x throughput gain.

- Self-reported figures include 94 tokens per second on an NVIDIA RTX 5070 and 60 on an AMD RX 9070 XT at Q2_0 quantization.

Strata, an MIT-licensed open-source inference engine, claims to run Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, a 125-billion-parameter model, on a single consumer GPU with 12 GB of VRAM and 32 GB of system memory.

The README's architectural explanation is unusually plain: "The model is a team of 24,576 small specialists ('experts'). Each word needs only 10 of them." That sparse routing is what lets a nominally 125B model fit a gaming rig at all. Strata keeps the hot experts on the GPU and offloads the rest to system RAM, which the project describes in kitchen terms: "the things you use all the time stay on the counter, and the rest waits in the pantry."

…

item.title: The Redis Guy Wrote a Local LLM Engine That Refuses to Be General. That's Why It Works.
item.description:
发表方：DEV Community（作者 Ashraf）　发布：2026-10-03　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题 Redis 作者 antirez 开源本地推理引擎 ds4，主动走「窄而深」路线，两周收获约 23k stars。

要点 只支持少数模型（DeepSeek V4/V4.1 Flash、GLM 5.x、Qwen 3.8 Flash Next），且必须用项目自产 GGUF；MoE 路由专家压到约 2bit 非对称量化、敏感部分保高精度；KV cache 压缩并按 prompt hash 持久化到 SSD 续用；约 95GiB 的 n-gram 表直接磁盘读，使约 42GiB 权重在 64GB Mac 上可行；服务暴露 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容 API。

关键数字 65K 上下文下 Mac 生成速度从 39 降到 27 t/s；独立报道 M5 Max 约 35 t/s。

为什么值得看 「反通用化」把加载、KV、工具调用、HTTP 服务整体调通，是本地长会话 agent 降本的实用样本。
